common.tagline: One match a month. Chosen with care.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

email.title: Let's get started
email.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a code to sign in or register — no password needed.

register.title: A few details about you
register.subtitle: Ainima is a marriage agency, not a dating app: we take the time to get to know you before proposing anyone.
register.telefonoHint: Shared with the other party only once a match is confirmed — not verified at this stage.

sensitiveConsent.title: Before you continue
sensitiveConsent.intro: To propose truly compatible matches, we need to ask for some information the law (Article 9 of the GDPR) classifies as "special category data" — handled with more care than ordinary personal details.
sensitiveConsent.categoryOrientation: Your sexual orientation (on the next screen) — needed to propose people who are genuinely compatible with you.
sensitiveConsent.categoryReligion: Your religious faith, later in your profile — always optional.
sensitiveConsent.why: This data is used exclusively for the matching algorithm and is never shown publicly or shared with the other party before a confirmed match.
sensitiveConsent.rights: You can request that this data be changed or deleted at any time by contacting support.
sensitiveConsent.consentCheckbox: I explicitly consent to the processing of these special categories of data for the matching purposes described above.

orientation.title: One last thing
orientation.subtitle: It helps us propose only people who are genuinely compatible with you.

payment.title: Register a payment method
payment.subtitle: A symbolic pre-authorization, no charge at all. You'll only pay the match fee if and when a match is confirmed by both parties.
payment.disclaimer: Development environment: no real payment gateway is connected — this module only simulates card tokenization.

civilStatus.title: Your civil status
civilStatus.subtitle: Self-declared information — we don't perform civil registry checks at this stage.

profile.title: Tell us a bit more about yourself
profile.subtitle: This information helps the algorithm find you a truly compatible match.
profile.stileVitaSportPlaceholder: E.g. running twice a week, no sport, gym...
profile.importanzaReligione: How important is religion in your life? (1-5)

photos.title: Your photos
photos.subtitle: A profile photo is required to activate your account. The ideal-partner photo is optional.
photos.profileHint: Visible to the other party only after a confirmed match.
photos.idealHint: A purely visual aesthetic reference — not a real profile. It's used only as a secondary tie-breaker between two candidates already highly compatible on character, never as a primary matching criterion.
photos.moderationNote: Every uploaded photo goes through a review before being made visible to other users.

preferences.title: What you're looking for in a partner
preferences.subtitle: We split your criteria into two groups, weighted differently by the algorithm.
preferences.dealbreakerSubtitle: Rule out a profile outright — no candidate who doesn't meet these will ever be proposed to you.
preferences.softSubtitle: Contribute to the compatibility score but don't rule anyone out.
preferences.importanzaVicinanza: How much does geographic closeness matter to you? (1-5)
preferences.importanzaVicinanzaHint: Within an urban area, distance barely matters anyway; beyond that, this value decides how much it counts.
preferences.lingueParlate: Languages you could sustain a relationship in
preferences.lingueParlateHint: Comma-separated. Beyond the urban area, you need a language in common with the other person.
preferences.accettaFigli: Would you accept a partner with children?
preferences.desideraFigliFuturi: Do you want children in the future?
preferences.importanzaReligione: Preferred importance of religion for the partner (1-5)

bigfive.title: Personality test
bigfive.subtitle: 41 statements, no right or wrong answer: go with your gut.

interview.title: A brief interview
interview.subtitle: A free-flowing conversation, guided by an AI interviewer — a few minutes, no right or wrong. It helps us better understand your story and what you're looking for in a relationship.
interview.completed: Interview complete — thank you for sharing your story.

attaccamento.title: How you experience closeness
attaccamento.subtitle: 19 statements, no right or wrong answer: go with your gut, thinking about your romantic relationships.

eq.title: How you handle emotions
eq.subtitle: 25 statements, no right or wrong answer: go with your gut.

profiloRelazionale.title: Values, lifestyle, and aspirations
profiloRelazionale.subtitle: 26 statements about you and the partner you picture — no right or wrong answer: go with your gut.

narrative.title: Tell us about yourself
narrative.subtitle: Two free-form descriptions, used only to write your profile summary and match report — they don't affect the compatibility score.
narrative.descrizioneDiSeHint: Who you are, what matters to you day to day.
narrative.descrizionePartnerIdealeHint: Not a list of adjectives: try picturing an everyday scene together.

interestTags.title: Likes & dislikes
interestTags.subtitle: A few words for each list, separated by commas. Unlike the previous section, these lists really do factor into your match score.
interestTags.miPiaceHint: Interests, activities, small things that make you feel good.
interestTags.nonSopportoHint: Attitudes or habits that just aren't for you.
interestTags.partnerVorrei: What you'd want in a partner
interestTags.partnerVorreiHint: Qualities or interests you'd value in the person you'll meet.
interestTags.partnerNonVorrei: What you wouldn't want in a partner
interestTags.partnerNonVorreiHint: Traits or habits you'd rather avoid.

summary.title: You're all set
summary.subtitleActive: Your account is active. From now on, you'll receive at most one match proposal per month.
summary.subtitlePending: A few steps are still incomplete before your account can become active.
summary.reportEmailSent: Your personalized analysis "Your Relationship Readiness" has been sent to you by email — you'll also find it on your home page.

dashboard.title: Your home
dashboard.greetingPending: Your account is still being activated.
dashboard.hasProposalSubtitle: Someone who might be right for you is waiting.
dashboard.nothingPending: Your profile is up to date. We'll write as soon as there's something new.

personalReport.title: Your Relationship Readiness
personalReport.subtitle: Your personalized analysis, generated from the tests you've completed.

feedback.question: How much do you recognize yourself in this analysis?
feedback.commentPlaceholder: Tell us more (optional) — it helps us improve future analyses

photos.title: Your photos
photos.subtitle: Replace them any time — new photos go through automatic review again.
photos.pendingModeration: The new photo is under review — the previous one stays visible until it's approved.

proposal.title: This month's proposal
proposal.noProposalSubtitle: No cause for concern: if no truly compatible profile came up this month, we'd rather propose nothing than a mediocre match. Check back next cycle.
proposal.anonymousNote: Profile shown anonymously — you'll see the name and contact only after confirmation from both sides.
proposal.confirmReject: Are you sure? This proposal won't come back.
proposal.youAccepted: You accepted — waiting for the other party's response.
proposal.analysisTitle: How well what you're each looking for lines up
proposal.analysisNotReady: The analysis will be available shortly.
proposal.narrativeScoreHint: How consistent what this person says about themselves is with what you're looking for, and vice versa.
proposal.paySubtitle: Both parties need to confirm payment of the match fee to exchange contact details.
proposal.emailPrivacyNote: If you proceed, your email will be shown to the other person once the exchange is confirmed. We recommend using an address you don't link to your other online profiles.
proposal.waitingOtherPayment: Waiting for the other party's payment.

rubrica.title: Your contacts
rubrica.subtitle: Successfully concluded matches.
rubrica.empty: You don't have any contacts here yet. Once a match is confirmed by both parties, it'll show up on this page.
rubrica.analysisNotReady: Analysis not yet available for this couple.
rubrica.narrativeScoreHint: Coherence between your values and your relationship expectations.

profileEdit.title: Your profile
profileEdit.subtitle: Review and update anytime the information you've shared with us.

preferencesEdit.title: Your search criteria
preferencesEdit.subtitle: Review them anytime — if you haven't been getting proposals lately, loosening them can help.
